thread:
Alex: Quick sync — v2 deprecation/rollout plan. TL;DR: staged rollout starting Mon 2026-03-23, canary in us-west, gradual ramp to 100% by Fri. Need owners for SDK migrations, compat shims, docs, and canary metrics. Who's got migration guide PR?
Maria: I'm owner for Python SDK. PR #5123 has the breaking-change notes. Need a reviewer for the auth changes. @Jon can you take a look? :eyes:
Jon: On it. I'll review today and ping for followups. Is there a compatibility shim for legacy `Completion` params?
Alex: Yes — we added a `compat` flag in v2 server that maps `prompt` -> `input` and keeps old `max_tokens` semantics. But it requires client-side opt-in until we flip the default in 60 days.
Emily: Docs question: do we want to publish migration guide before canary or simultaneously? I prefer before so early adopters can test.
Raja: Agree with Emily. I'll put up a skeleton migration page and link to the SDK PRs. ETA: Tue EOD.
Prashant: Deploy-bot, canary window for us-west scheduled?
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started to us-west-2 at 2026-03-23T02:00Z. Traffic: 1% -> 5% ramp planned over 3 hours. Monitor: /dashboards/v2-canary
Maria: Heads up: Python SDK PR depends on pkg bump in internal client lib. Might need a quick Dedicated-hotfix for a serialization bug.
Alex: Noted. @Prashant can you coordinate hotfix with eng-infra? We should avoid blocking canary.
Prashant: On it. I'll open a hotfix ticket and tag eng-infra. Ticket: HOT-764.
Jon: Reviewed #5123 — left comments about error message parity. Also added a unit test suggestion for `rate_limit` header fallback.
Maria: Thanks — pushing changes now.
Raja: Docs draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/migrate-v2 (will convert to public once PRs are merged). Contains sample `curl` and `python` snippets. Example: `curl -X POST /v2/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'` (note: use v2 endpoint)
Emily: Quick ask: do we have SDK semver policy for this breaking change? Major bump required?
Alex: Yes. v2 requires major bump for SDKs. Plan: Python 2.0.0, JS 2.0.0. Add migration notes in CHANGELOG.
Prashant: Can someone own monitoring alerts? I can set up basic SLOs but need signal owners for quality regressions.
Jon: I'll own generation-quality regression alerts (eval infra). Will wire up diff checks against baseline prompts.
Maria: I'll own SDK release pipeline for Python and coordinate cut and PyPI publish.
Alex: Final checklist before Monday canary: 1) SDK PRs merged (owners: Maria/JS lead), 2) Docs published (Raja), 3) Hotfix resolved (Prashant), 4) Monitoring config (Jon), 5) Migration guide announced to customers (Emily). If we hit blockers, pause canary.
Emily: I'll draft the customer note once docs are public. Target: Wed morning.
Raja: One more dependency: internal infra flag `v2_compat_mode` must be toggled during canary. @eng-infra please confirm toggle automation.
Prashant: I'll follow up with eng-infra now.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Quick reactions: :thumbsup: if you accept action items, else reply with conflicts.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jon: :thumbsup:
Emily: :thumbsup:
Raja: :thumbsup:
Prashant: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 5% complete at 2026-03-23T05:00Z. No errors > 5xx observed in last 30m.
Alex: Great — will reconvene if issues. Otherwise plan to proceed with progressive rollout. End of thread.
